title: Home

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Up" FROM node_status WHERE status = 'up';
SELECT count(*) AS "Down" FROM node_status WHERE status <> 'up' OR status IS NULL;
SELECT count(*) AS "Up" FROM service_registry WHERE status = 'up';
SELECT count(*) AS "Down" FROM service_registry WHERE status = 'down';
SELECT ts AS time, temp_f FROM telemetry.weather ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT ts AS time, humidity FROM telemetry.weather ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT person AS "Person", room AS "Room", activity_state AS "Activity", round(confidence::numeric,2) AS "Confidence", last_confirmed AS "Last Seen" FROM presence_state ORDER BY person;

SELECT node_name AS "Node", status AS "Status", host(node_ip) AS "IP", os_family AS "OS", load_avg_1m AS "Load 1m", round(memory_percent::numeric,1) AS "Mem %", round(disk_percent::numeric,1) AS "Disk %", last_heartbeat AS "Heartbeat" FROM node_status ORDER BY node_name;

SELECT service_name AS "Service", node_name AS "Node", host(host) AS "Host", port AS "Port", status AS "Status", last_heartbeat AS "Heartbeat" FROM service_registry ORDER BY (status='up') DESC, service_name;
SELECT ts AS time, temp_f AS "Outdoor Temp", feels_like_f AS "Feels Like", dew_point_f AS "Dew Point", temp_indoor_f AS "Indoor Temp" FROM telemetry.weather WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;
SELECT ts AS time, humidity AS "Outdoor Humidity", humidity_indoor AS "Indoor Humidity", pressure_in AS "Pressure (inHg)" FROM telemetry.weather WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;
SELECT ts AS time, wind_speed_mph AS "Wind Speed", wind_gust_mph AS "Wind Gust" FROM telemetry.weather WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;
SELECT ts AS time, uv_index AS "UV Index", solar_radiation AS "Solar Radiation" FROM telemetry.weather WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;
SELECT ts AS time, room AS metric, temp_f FROM telemetry.climate WHERE temp_f IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;
SELECT ts AS time, room AS metric, humidity FROM telemetry.climate WHERE humidity IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;

SELECT person AS "Person", room AS "Room", activity_state AS "Activity", round(confidence::numeric,2) AS "Confidence", source AS "Source", last_confirmed AS "Last Confirmed" FROM presence_state ORDER BY person;
SELECT ts AS "Time", person AS "Person", room AS "Room", round(confidence::numeric,2) AS "Confidence", method AS "Method" FROM telemetry.presence WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (room) room AS "Room", person AS "Person", round(confidence::numeric,2) AS "Confidence", method AS "Method", ts AS "Last Seen" FROM telemetry.presence WHERE method = 'mmwave' AND confidence > 0 AND ts > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY room, ts DESC;
SELECT ts AS time, room AS metric, confidence AS value FROM telemetry.presence WHERE method = 'mmwave' AND confidence IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;
SELECT ts AS time, room AS metric, temp_f AS value FROM telemetry.climate WHERE source = 'fp300' AND temp_f IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;
SELECT ts AS time, room AS metric, humidity AS value FROM telemetry.climate WHERE source = 'fp300' AND humidity IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;
SELECT ts AS time, room AS metric, light_lux AS value FROM telemetry.climate WHERE source = 'fp300' AND light_lux IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;
SELECT ts AS time, co2 FROM telemetry.air_quality WHERE co2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT ts AS time, aqi_pm25 FROM telemetry.air_quality WHERE aqi_pm25 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT ts AS time, pm25 AS "PM2.5", pm10 AS "PM10" FROM telemetry.air_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;
SELECT DISTINCT ON (entity_id) friendly_name AS metric, state_numeric AS value FROM telemetry.ha_sensors WHERE device_class='battery' AND state_numeric IS NOT NULL ORDER BY entity_id, ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT ON (entity_id) friendly_name AS "Device", COALESCE(area,'-') AS "Area", state_numeric AS "Battery %", ts AS "Last Seen" FROM telemetry.ha_sensors WHERE device_class='battery' AND state_numeric IS NOT NULL ORDER BY entity_id, ts DESC

SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (entity_id) friendly_name AS "Device", COALESCE(area,'-') AS "Area", state_numeric AS "Battery %", ts AS "Last Seen" FROM telemetry.ha_sensors WHERE device_class='battery' AND state_numeric IS NOT NULL ORDER BY entity_id, ts DESC) q WHERE q."Battery %" < 25 ORDER BY q."Battery %" ASC
SELECT ts AS time, friendly_name AS metric, state_numeric FROM telemetry.ha_sensors WHERE device_class='battery' AND state_numeric IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, friendly_name AS metric, state_numeric FROM telemetry.ha_sensors WHERE device_class='illuminance' AND state_numeric IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time, friendly_name AS metric, state_numeric FROM telemetry.ha_sensors WHERE device_class IN ('pm25','pm10','pm1','carbon_dioxide','carbon_monoxide','volatile_organic_compounds','volatile_organic_compounds_parts','nitrogen_dioxide','ozone','aqi') AND state_numeric IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, friendly_name AS metric, state_numeric FROM telemetry.ha_sensors WHERE device_class='temperature' AND state_numeric IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time, friendly_name AS metric, state_numeric FROM telemetry.ha_sensors WHERE device_class IN ('motion','occupancy','door','window','opening','presence','vibration') AND state_numeric IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

SELECT DISTINCT ON (entity_id) friendly_name AS "Lock", COALESCE(area,'-') AS "Area", COALESCE(state_text, CASE WHEN state_numeric=0 THEN 'locked' WHEN state_numeric=1 THEN 'unlocked' END) AS "State", ts AS "Last Seen" FROM telemetry.ha_sensors WHERE domain='lock' OR device_class='lock' ORDER BY entity_id, ts DESC

SELECT DISTINCT ON (entity_id) friendly_name AS "Entity", domain AS "Domain", COALESCE(area,'-') AS "Area", COALESCE(state_text,'') AS "State", state_numeric AS "Brightness", ts AS "Last Seen" FROM telemetry.ha_sensors WHERE domain IN ('light','switch') ORDER BY entity_id, ts DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "On" FROM hue_light_state WHERE is_on = true
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Off" FROM hue_light_state WHERE is_on = false
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Unreachable" FROM hue_light_state WHERE reachable = false
SELECT room AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM hue_light_state GROUP BY room ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT room AS "Room", name AS "Light", CASE WHEN is_on THEN 'ON' ELSE 'off' END AS "State", brightness AS "Brightness", CASE WHEN reachable THEN 'yes' ELSE 'NO' END AS "Reachable" FROM hue_light_state ORDER BY room, name
SELECT CASE WHEN confidence > 0 THEN 'HOME' ELSE 'AWAY' END AS "Status" FROM telemetry.presence WHERE method = 'gps_tracker' AND person = 'jordan' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT state AS "Activity" FROM telemetry.activity WHERE person = 'jordan' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(DISTINCT method) AS "Methods" FROM telemetry.presence WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 day'
SELECT ts AS time, room AS metric, max(confidence) AS value FROM telemetry.presence WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND confidence > 0 GROUP BY ts, room ORDER BY ts
SELECT method AS "Method", count(*) AS "Events" FROM telemetry.presence WHERE ts > now() - interval '6 hours' GROUP BY method ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT ts AS time, 'Activity' AS metric, state FROM telemetry.activity WHERE person = 'jordan' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT DISTINCT ON (device) device AS "Device", level FROM telemetry.battery WHERE level IS NOT NULL ORDER BY device, ts DESC
SELECT voc AS "VOC (ug/m3)" FROM telemetry.air_quality WHERE voc IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT temp_f FROM telemetry.climate WHERE source='homekit' AND room='office' AND temp_f IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ts AS time, temp_f AS value, room AS metric FROM telemetry.climate WHERE temp_f IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, light_lux AS value, room AS metric FROM telemetry.climate WHERE light_lux IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, humidity AS value, room AS metric FROM telemetry.climate WHERE humidity IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, voc AS value, room AS metric FROM telemetry.air_quality WHERE voc IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT count(*) FROM telemetry.zigbee_link WHERE ts=(SELECT max(ts) FROM telemetry.zigbee_link)
SELECT count(*) FROM telemetry.zigbee_link WHERE type='Router' AND ts=(SELECT max(ts) FROM telemetry.zigbee_link)
SELECT round(avg(lqi)) FROM telemetry.zigbee_link WHERE ts=(SELECT max(ts) FROM telemetry.zigbee_link)
SELECT count(*) FROM telemetry.zigbee_link WHERE lqi < 50 AND ts=(SELECT max(ts) FROM telemetry.zigbee_link)
SELECT ts AS time, lqi AS value, device AS metric FROM telemetry.zigbee_link WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Link quality per device (watch it climb as the mesh settles)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, count(*) AS value, 'devices' AS metric FROM telemetry.zigbee_link WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts
SELECT device AS "Device", type AS "Type", lqi AS "LQI" FROM telemetry.zigbee_link WHERE ts=(SELECT max(ts) FROM telemetry.zigbee_link) ORDER BY lqi
SELECT moisture_pct FROM telemetry.soil WHERE sensor='soil1' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT moisture_pct FROM telemetry.soil WHERE sensor='soil2' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT moisture_pct FROM telemetry.soil WHERE sensor='soil3' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT pm25 FROM telemetry.weather WHERE pm25 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT co2 FROM telemetry.weather WHERE co2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ts AS time, moisture_pct AS value, sensor AS metric FROM telemetry.soil WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, pm25 AS value, 'outdoor PM2.5' AS metric FROM telemetry.weather WHERE pm25 IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, co2 AS value, 'CO2 ppm' AS metric FROM telemetry.weather WHERE co2 IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, pm10 AS value, 'indoor PM10' AS metric FROM telemetry.weather WHERE pm10 IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT temp_f FROM telemetry.aux_sensors WHERE channel=1 ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT humidity FROM telemetry.aux_sensors WHERE channel=1 ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT battery FROM telemetry.aux_sensors WHERE channel=1 ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ts AS time, temp_f FROM telemetry.aux_sensors WHERE channel=1 AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, humidity FROM telemetry.aux_sensors WHERE channel=1 AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT count(DISTINCT device_mac) FROM telemetry.bluetooth WHERE ts > now() - interval '5 min'
SELECT count(DISTINCT device_mac) FROM telemetry.bluetooth WHERE is_connected = true AND ts > now() - interval '5 min'
SELECT count(DISTINCT device_id) FROM telemetry.av_state a WHERE power IN ('on','ON','true') AND ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM telemetry.av_state b WHERE b.device_id = a.device_id)

SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_mac) coalesce(device_name, device_mac) AS "Device", device_type AS "Type", rssi AS "RSSI", battery_pct AS "Battery %" FROM telemetry.bluetooth WHERE ts > now() - interval '10 min' ORDER BY device_mac, ts DESC

SELECT ts AS time, rssi AS value, coalesce(device_name, device_mac) AS metric FROM telemetry.bluetooth WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device_mac IN (SELECT device_mac FROM telemetry.bluetooth WHERE ts > now() - interval '30 min' GROUP BY device_mac ORDER BY max(rssi) DESC LIMIT 10) ORDER BY ts

SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_id) device_id AS "Device", device_type AS "Type", zone AS "Zone", power AS "Power", source_input AS "Source", volume AS "Volume", media_title AS "Now Playing" FROM telemetry.av_state WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 day' ORDER BY device_id, ts DESC

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE power_state) AS value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (uid) room,accessory,outlet,power_state,in_use,ts FROM telemetry.homekit_outlets WHERE ts>now()-interval '15 min' ORDER BY uid, ts DESC) s

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE in_use) AS value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (uid) room,accessory,outlet,power_state,in_use,ts FROM telemetry.homekit_outlets WHERE ts>now()-interval '15 min' ORDER BY uid, ts DESC) s
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (uid) room,accessory,outlet,power_state,in_use,ts FROM telemetry.homekit_outlets WHERE ts>now()-interval '15 min' ORDER BY uid, ts DESC) s

SELECT count(DISTINCT room) AS value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (uid) room,accessory,outlet,power_state,in_use,ts FROM telemetry.homekit_outlets WHERE ts>now()-interval '15 min' ORDER BY uid, ts DESC) s

SELECT $__timeGroup(ts,'5m') AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE in_use) AS "In use", count(*) FILTER (WHERE power_state) AS "Powered" FROM telemetry.homekit_outlets WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT room AS metric, count(*) FILTER (WHERE in_use) AS value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (uid) room,accessory,outlet,power_state,in_use,ts FROM telemetry.homekit_outlets WHERE ts>now()-interval '15 min' ORDER BY uid, ts DESC) s GROUP BY room HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE in_use)>0

SELECT room AS "Room", accessory AS "Accessory", outlet AS "Outlet", CASE WHEN power_state THEN '🟢 on' ELSE '⚫ off' END AS "Power", CASE WHEN in_use THEN 'yes' ELSE '—' END AS "In use" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (uid) room,accessory,outlet,power_state,in_use,ts FROM telemetry.homekit_outlets WHERE ts>now()-interval '15 min' ORDER BY uid, ts DESC) s ORDER BY power_state DESC, room
SELECT ts AS "Time", device_id AS "Device", event AS "Event" FROM telemetry.device_power_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_on) AS value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (light_id) * FROM telemetry.hue_light_history WHERE ts>now()-interval '6 min' ORDER BY light_id, ts DESC) s
SELECT round(sum(est_watts)::numeric,0) AS value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (light_id) * FROM telemetry.hue_light_history WHERE ts>now()-interval '6 min' ORDER BY light_id, ts DESC) s

SELECT round(avg(ct_kelvin)) AS value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (light_id) * FROM telemetry.hue_light_history WHERE ts>now()-interval '6 min' ORDER BY light_id, ts DESC) s WHERE is_on AND colormode='ct'
SELECT round((sum(est_watts)*(2.0/60.0)/1000.0*0.18)::numeric,2) AS value FROM telemetry.hue_light_history WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)

SELECT $__timeGroup(ts,'2m') AS time, avg(ct_kelvin) AS "Avg K (warm↓ / cool↑)" FROM telemetry.hue_light_history WHERE is_on AND colormode='ct' AND ct_kelvin IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroup(ts,'2m') AS time, COALESCE(room,'(unassigned)') AS metric, sum(est_watts) AS value FROM telemetry.hue_light_history WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, room ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroup(ts,'2m') AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_on) AS "On" FROM telemetry.hue_light_history WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT CASE WHEN colormode='ct' THEN 'white (ct)' ELSE 'color ('||colormode||')' END AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM telemetry.hue_light_history WHERE is_on AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Color usage (on bulbs: white vs color)

targets.rawSql: SELECT name AS metric, round(100.0*avg(CASE WHEN is_on THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS value FROM telemetry.hue_light_history WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY name HAVING avg(CASE WHEN is_on THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT name AS "Light", room AS "Room", CASE WHEN is_on THEN '🟢 on' ELSE '⚫ off' END AS "State", round(bri_pct) AS "Bri %", ct_kelvin AS "Kelvin", colormode AS "Mode", CASE WHEN reachable THEN 'yes' ELSE 'NO' END AS "Reach" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (light_id) * FROM telemetry.hue_light_history WHERE ts>now()-interval '6 min' ORDER BY light_id, ts DESC) s ORDER BY is_on DESC, room, name

SELECT name AS "Light", room AS "Room", CASE WHEN reachable THEN 'reachable' ELSE '❌ UNREACHABLE' END AS "Status" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (light_id) * FROM telemetry.hue_light_history WHERE ts>now()-interval '6 min' ORDER BY light_id, ts DESC) s ORDER BY reachable, name
